title: amelanchier alnifolia subsp. pallida
intro: Amelanchier alnifolia subsp. pallida, commonly known as the White Serviceberry, is a deciduous shrub native to North America, belonging to the Rosaceae family. The White Serviceberry has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Amelanchier alnifolia subsp. pallida include astringent and demulcent effects, making it useful for treating gastrointestinal issues and promoting wound healing. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
